direction.name: Living Lacquer
direction.summary: Slush Home/Card hierarchy with quiet balance cents and account/investment disclosure; Fomo Markets/Profile/Social; Phantom action fan; Senryo seal, gold leaf and lacquer. Existing native controls and operation flows retained.

sources.icons: native symbols: SF Symbols (iOS, expo-symbols) and vendored Material Symbols (Android) via src/components/kit/symbols.tsx (D-237)

fonts.sans: Inter 400/500/600/700 (Inter 4.1 static TTF, rsms/inter, OFL) — UI
fonts.display: Inter Display SemiBold (Inter 4.1 static) — big numbers and titles ≥ 32 pt, −0.02 em
fonts.jp: Noto Sans JP, subset to the glyphs we ship (千両金箔), OFL — Japanese only; the seal stays vector

typography.figures: tabular + lining (tnum, lnum) for money, quotes, fees and aligned columns

roles.legacy: micro/label/caption 12/16 · body/bodyStrong 16/22 · title 20/24 · numSm 16/20 · numMd 20/24 · numTicker/numLg 40/44 · numXl/numHero 52/56

radius.use: D-196: buttons 12 (56 pt) / 10 (44 pt, chips, mode control) · grouped cards and selector rows 20 · sheets 38 · onboarding hero 32 · pill only for the dock, the fan, avatars and dots
radius.compat: RADIUS.sm = 12 for components not rebuilt yet

families.press: scale 0.97 in 100 ms, back in 160 ms (D-196)
families.sheet: iOS drawer curve cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1), 480 ms in, 240 ms out; released drag: spring 1/320/32 with the finger's velocity; rows stagger 40 ms, 10 pt rise (M02/M12)
families.fan: 200 ms/item, 25 ms stagger, spring 1/420/30; Send overshoots; backdrop 160; plus→× 180 (45°); exit 180 (M06)
families.dockActive: bubble: spring 1/420/30 with a small overshoot, stretches 1.14× while it travels; arriving icon pops 1.1× (M10, D-196)

motion.reducedMotion: static art, ~100 ms crossfades; reduced transparency → opaque glass/fan backdrop
motion.haptics: selection ticks, one on submit, one on the confirmed outcome; no sound by default

materials.glass: dock only (expo-glass-effect on iOS 26; blur + glassTint elsewhere; glassOpaque under reduced transparency)
materials.blur: strong live blur only behind the fan (expo-blur) + fanScrim
materials.dim: ordinary sheets dim the parent (sheetScrim); no universal sheet blur
materials.elevation: dock 0/8/24 #00000033; sheet 0/−4/16 #0000001F; primary button 0/2/4 #00000029; raised content has no shadow
materials.surfaces: D-196: no borders on cards, groups, notes, chips or buttons — a surface is one step lighter than its ground (SurfaceLevel); 1 pt inner top highlights give buttons, sheets and the dock bubble their depth; borders only for inputs, focus and glass rims
materials.gold: gold identifies Senryo and Kinpaku; never buy, profit, warning or mainnet

design.density: comfortable: rounded controls, rows ≥ 64, 20 pt inset
must: Reference evidence first: every component names its C/F/M evidence IDs and declared deviations here before it is built
Colours only from @senryo/tokens (theme/ on mobile, tokens.css on web); no hex/rgba elsewhere
Known entities render their real first-party mark (EntityMark, @senryo/identity); Lucide icons identify actions only
Mode capsule ('Practice · Paper money' violet / 'Mainnet · Real money' blue) on every money surface; P$ for paper
Success only after finalization; the 500 ms hold confirms (D-177) with an accessible explicit alternative
Reading<T>: skeleton → value → stale/unavailable; never a fabricated $0.00 or tick
Content padded clear of the dock; tab, stack and scroll restored; parents restored after every sheet
avoid: D2 terminal identity: pure black, monospace amounts, green/yellow primaries, 4 px corners, hairline grids, tracked caps
universal sheet blur, literal radial fans, flat-logo 'material' wobble
success flourishes on submit; celebratory motion before the real outcome
generic coins, letter discs or recoloured approximations for known entities
an available component dictating layout or dropping states (C40 is never a plain slider)
fictitious 21st attribution for a custom reconstruction
framer-motion imports (use motion/react on web); floats for money

reconstructions.name: slide-to-confirm

reconstructions.port: ReactionEngine ported with the same thresholds (steps, surges z ≥ 3 / mega z ≥ 4.5, ROI milestones, new high, comeback, near the line, callout gate); callouts ride the chart head via a UI-thread shared value; inset edge glow 0.9 s via boxShadow; dispatch to the existing cue and haptic maps
